title: Summative Test 2 — Light, Sound & Chemistry in Everyday Life
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which statement correctly describes light?
options: An electromagnetic wave that can cross a vacuum
A mechanical wave that needs air to move
A longitudinal wave made only by vibrating air
A sound wave with a very high frequency
questions.correct: An electromagnetic wave that can cross a vacuum

questions.text: Which color of visible light has the LONGEST wavelength?
options: Red
Violet
Blue
Green

questions.text: Why do you see your reflection clearly in a still pool but not in a rippling one?
options: A smooth surface reflects light in one direction
Rippling water absorbs all the light that hits it
Still water produces its own light at the surface
Light travels slower over a rippling water surface
questions.correct: A smooth surface reflects light in one direction

questions.text: Which innovation uses light pulses in thin glass strands to carry phone and internet data?
options: Fiber-optic cable
Copper telephone wire
AM radio antenna
Satellite dish reflector

questions.text: Which device records a 3-D image using laser light?
options: Hologram
Periscope
Microscope
Prism

questions.text: Why are lasers used in eye surgery?
options: Their narrow, focused beam can cut very precisely
They make sound waves that break up the cornea
They spread light widely to gently warm the whole eye
They give off X-rays that pass through the eye
questions.correct: Their narrow, focused beam can cut very precisely

questions.text: Light travels 3 × 10⁸ m/s. About how long does it take to cross 1.5 × 10¹¹ m from the Sun to Earth?
A city must choose new streetlights. Which choice is BEST and why?
options: LEDs — same brightness, less power, longer life
Incandescent bulbs — they give off more useful heat
Candles — they need no electricity at all
Mirrors only — they reflect the moonlight
questions.correct: LEDs — same brightness, less power, longer life

questions.text: What is the normal range of human hearing?
options: 20 Hz to 20,000 Hz
0 Hz to 200 Hz
2 Hz to 2,000 Hz
200 kHz up to 2,000 kHz

questions.text: Which property of a sound wave determines its loudness?
options: Amplitude
Frequency
Wavelength
Period

questions.text: Why do you hear thunder after you see the lightning?
options: Light travels much faster than sound
Sound is produced after the light ends
Thunder bounces off the clouds first
Light and sound start at different times
questions.correct: Light travels much faster than sound

questions.text: A bat finds insects in the dark by sending out sounds and listening. What is this called?
options: Echolocation
Amplification
Refraction
Ionization

questions.text: What happens to the pitch of a guitar string when it is tightened?
options: It rises because the frequency increases
It drops because the amplitude increases
It stays the same; only loudness changes
It drops because the string gets shorter
questions.correct: It rises because the frequency increases

questions.text: Long exposure to sounds above about 85 dB can cause what?
options: Permanent hearing damage
Sharper hearing at night
A faster speed of sound in ears
Higher voice pitch

questions.text: You shout toward a cliff and hear the echo 2.0 s later. Sound in air travels 343 m/s. How far is the cliff?
A church hall has a lot of echo during Mass. Which change would reduce the echo MOST?
options: Add curtains, carpets and padded panels
Paint the walls with a glossy finish
Replace all the wooden pews with shiny metal
Use more loudspeakers turned up high
questions.correct: Add curtains, carpets and padded panels

questions.text: Louis Pasteur was trained mainly as what kind of scientist?
options: Chemist
Astronomer
Geologist
Physicist

questions.text: Which vaccines did Pasteur develop?
options: Anthrax and rabies
Polio and measles
Dengue and malaria
Flu and smallpox

questions.text: What did Pasteur show about fermentation of wine?
options: Living yeast cells cause it
Sunlight alone causes it
Air alone turns sugar into wine
Metal barrels speed it up

questions.text: Which pasteurization method heats milk to about 72 °C for 15 seconds?
options: HTST (high temperature, short time)
UHT (ultra-high temperature)
LTLT (low temperature, long time)
Sterilization by boiling for an hour

questions.text: Why is germ theory the reason doctors sterilize surgical tools?
options: Microbes on tools can cause infection
Clean tools cut the skin more quickly
Heat makes the metal tools sharper
Sterile tools are lighter to hold
questions.correct: Microbes on tools can cause infection

questions.text: In the swan-neck experiment, which single difference caused the broth to turn cloudy when the flask was tilted?
options: Broth touched dust and microbes in the neck
The broth was boiled for a second time
More air suddenly entered the flask
The flask became much warmer when it was tilted
questions.correct: Broth touched dust and microbes in the neck

questions.text: A friend says, "Washing a dog-bite wound and getting vaccinated is unnecessary if the dog looks healthy." Which response is BEST?
options: Wrong — rabies can be carried before signs show
Right — only dogs that look sick can carry rabies
Right — rabies spreads only through the air
Wrong — vaccines work only before a bite
questions.correct: Wrong — rabies can be carried before signs show

questions.text: Which ingredient in detergents surrounds grease so water can rinse it away?
options: Surfactants
Fragrances
Colorants
Preservatives

questions.text: Which agency regulates the disposal of hazardous chemical waste in the Philippines?
options: DENR
DTI
FDA
DepEd

questions.text: Why must bleach never be mixed with ammonia-based glass cleaners?
options: They react to release toxic chloramine gas
The mixture becomes too weak to disinfect
The bleach changes color and stains the glass
The ammonia makes the bleach freeze solid
questions.correct: They react to release toxic chloramine gas

questions.text: What does the DTI do for consumer products such as appliances and cleaners?
options: Enforces product standards and fair labeling
Approves new medicines and checks their safety
Collects and treats all hazardous waste
Tests the water quality in all rivers
questions.correct: Enforces product standards and fair labeling

questions.text: You are making a product table. Toothpaste lists "sodium fluoride 0.24%." What should you write under "function"?
options: Strengthens tooth enamel against acid
Gives the toothpaste its mint flavor
Makes the toothpaste foam in the mouth
Keeps the toothpaste from drying up

questions.text: Two shampoos cost the same. Shampoo A has an FDA notification number and full label; Shampoo B is repacked with no label. Which conclusion is BEST?
options: Choose A — its safety and ingredients are documented
Choose B — repacked products are always more natural
Either is fine — all shampoos contain the same chemicals
Choose B — no label means it has no harmful chemicals
questions.correct: Choose A — its safety and ingredients are documented

questions.text: A family pours leftover bleach and paint thinner into the canal behind their house. Which judgment is MOST accurate?
options: Harmful — it pollutes water and breaks DENR rules
Acceptable — canal water dilutes chemicals to zero
Acceptable — bleach cleans the canal water
Harmful — but only because it wastes product
questions.correct: Harmful — it pollutes water and breaks DENR rules
